# Sample Huawei VRP running-config fragment for golden tests.
# Mimics display current-configuration (secrets redacted).

sysname SW-ACCESS-01
#
undo telnet server enable
ssh server enable
#
aaa
 local-user admin password irreversible-cipher ******
 local-user admin privilege level 15
 local-user admin service-type ssh
#
vlan batch 10 20 30 100
#
interface Vlanif100
 description ## Management VLAN ##
 ip address 192.168.100.10 255.255.255.0
 undo shutdown
#
interface Eth-Trunk1
 description ## Uplink to Aggregation ##
 port link-type trunk
 port trunk allow-pass vlan 10 20 30 100
 undo shutdown
#
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 description ## Access Port - Floor 1 Room 01 PC-1 ##
 port link-type access
 port default vlan 20
 port-security enable
 port-security max-mac-num 2
 port-security mac-address sticky
 undo poe power-off
 undo shutdown
#
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/2
 description ## Access Port - Floor 1 Room 01 PC-2 ##
 port link-type access
 port default vlan 20
 port-security enable
 port-security max-mac-num 2
 port-security mac-address sticky
 undo poe power-off
 undo shutdown
#
# ... remaining GE ports omitted in fixture; tests that need all 24 use rendered template ...
#
dhcp snooping enable
dhcp snooping trusted interface Eth-Trunk1
#
return
